retry_signal: JSON/schema/response shape or transport/API failures; semantic labels are never retry signals
seed_strategy: Ordinal 0 uses the frozen base seed. Ordinal >=1 uses the first 16 hex digits of SHA256('judge-bench-retry-v1:' + base_seed + ':' + item_id + ':' + ordinal), modulo 2147483647; increment modulo 2147483647 on collision with any prior seed. Ordinal counts every persisted HTTP attempt for that item across invocations.
source: All demonstrations are training annotations; target checkpoint excluded across source models
comparison_scope: Same new fixed 800 targets as Qwen v3; GPT uses labeled demonstrations, so this is not a matched zero-shot model comparison
thinking: API default: reasoning_effort omitted from every request; missing separate reasoning usage remains unknown
